body.p: AMENDMENTS TO THE CLAIMS Listing of claims:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A wearable device comprising:a housing;
a circuit board disposed within the housing;
a screen comprising:a display region;
a connecting section;
a groove disposed on the connecting section and on a portion of the display region;
a first electrode disposed in the groove and coupled to the screen so that the first electrode does not shield the display region, wherein the first electrode comprises a first surface; and
a second electrode mounted on the housing, wherein the second electrode comprises a second surface,
wherein the first electrode and the second electrode are electrically coupled by the circuit board, and
wherein the first surface and the second surface are configured to contact a human body of a wearer.
2. (Canceled)
3. (Currently Amended) The wearable device of claim [[2]]_1, wherein the first electrode comprises nanometal.
4. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 3, further comprising a plurality of grooves disposed in the screen, wherein the grooves are distributed in a form of a grid, wherein a nanometal is disposed in each ofthe grooves, and wherein adjacent nanometals are coupled to each other to define the first electrode.
5. (Currently Amended) The wearable device of claim [[2]]_1, wherein the screen further comprises a third surface facing away from the circuit board, wherein the groove is disposed in the third surface, wherein the wearable device further comprises a conductive protective layer disposed on the third surface, and wherein the further comprising a conductive protective layer disposed on covers a region of the screen in which the first electrode is located and that is electrically coupled to the first electrode.
6. (Currently Amended) The wearable device of claim 5, wherein the screen further comprises a second side facing away from the third surface, and wherein the first electrode further comprises:
a first main body part disposed in the groove;
a second main body part disposed on the second side and configured to electrically couple to the circuit board; and
a connecting section coupled to the first main body part and the second main body part to electrically couple the first main body part and the second main body part.
7. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 1, wherein the housing is coupled to the screen, and wherein the first electrode is defined by a portion of the housing comprising conductive ceramic.
8. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 7, wherein the first electrode comprises a ring around a circumference of the screen.
9. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 7, further comprising an elastic part through which the first electrode is electrically coupled to the circuit board.
10. (Currently Amended) The wearable device of claim 1, wherein the housing comprises a second third surface facing away from the screen, and wherein the second electrode is disposed on the second third surface.
11. (Currently Amended) The wearable device of claim 10, further comprising a first side configured to contact a wearer, wherein the housing comprises a bottom housing that is located on the first side configured to contact a wearer, and wherein the second third surface is on the bottom housing.
12. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 10, further comprising a plurality of second electrodes.
13. (Currently Amended) The wearable device of claim 1, further comprising an electrocardiogram module system electrically coupled to the first electrode and the second electrode by the circuit board.
14. (Currently Amended) The wearable device of claim 1, further comprising a photoplethysmography module system mounted on the housing and configured to detect a heart rate of the human body.
15. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 1, wherein the first electrode comprises a conductive ceramic disposed on the housing.
16. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 1, wherein the housing comprises conductive ceramic.
17. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 1, wherein the wearable device is a smart band.
18. (Currently Amended) The wearable device of claim [[2]] 1 wherein the screen first side further comprises an edge, and wherein the groove is further disposed on the edge.
19. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 3, wherein the nanometal comprises a nano silver paste.
20. (Previously Presented) The wearable device of claim 5, wherein the conductive protective layer is a transparent conductive protective layer and is disposed on the third surface using a manner of spraying.
21. (New) The wearable device of claim 1, wherein the housing consists of conductive ceramic sleeved to the screen in the form of a ring.
